ledger: numbered cube blocks | set of 2 numbered blocks on wooden table at start | set of 8 numbered blocks arranged in a line at end | continuous duplication of blocks and spontaneous transformation of face numbers as the hand drags the rightmost block

findings.description: Additional numbered blocks spontaneously duplicate and appear in the line as the hand slides the blocks across the table, increasing the total count from 2 blocks to 8 blocks without any external source.
The number printed on the front face of the rightmost cube morphs from '3' to '6' without the block being rotated or physically altered.
